<!-- wp:html --><style>
/* Hide TT4 theme chrome */
.wp-site-blocks > header, .wp-site-blocks > footer, header.wp-block-template-part, footer.wp-block-template-part, .wp-block-template-part:first-child { display: none !important; }
.wp-block-post-title, .wp-block-spacer { display: none !important; }
html, body, .wp-site-blocks { background: #080E1C !important; background-color: #080E1C !important; }
#pacerai-homepage { width: 100%; max-width: 100vw; overflow-x: hidden; }
.wp-site-blocks, .wp-site-blocks > main, .wp-site-blocks > main > .wp-block-group, .wp-site-blocks .is-layout-constrained, .wp-site-blocks .is-layout-constrained > :where(:not(.alignleft):not(.alignright):not(.alignfull)), .has-global-padding, .entry-content { max-width: none !important; padding-left: 0 !important; padding-right: 0 !important; margin-left: 0 !important; margin-right: 0 !important; padding-top: 0 !important; }

  :root {
    --navy: #080E1C; --navy-mid: #0F1929; --navy-light: #162038; --navy-border: #1E2D4A;
    --brand: #1C3560; --brand-blue: #2B7DC8; --teal: #27899A; --teal-light: #70C49C;
    --teal-pale: #D6F0E8; --cream: #F7F3EC; --white: #FFFFFF; --muted: #8A95A8;
    --text-light: #CDD5E0; --text-mid: #94A3B8; --green: #2DB87A; --red-subtle: #C94C4C;
  }

  #pacerai-homepage * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
  #pacerai-homepage { font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; background: var(--navy); color: var(--text-light); overflow-x: hidden; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.65; scroll-behavior: smooth; }

  /* ─── NAV ─── */
  #pacerai-homepage nav { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 100; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0 48px; height: 68px; background: rgba(8,14,28,0.92); backdrop-filter: blur(14px); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(28,53,96,0.6); }
  #pacerai-homepage .nav-logo { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; text-decoration: none; }
  #pacerai-homepage .nav-links { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; list-style: none; }
  #pacerai-homepage .nav-links > li { position: relative; }
  #pacerai-homepage .nav-links > li > a { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 8px 14px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: var(--text-mid); text-decoration: none; border-radius: 6px; transition: color 0.2s, background 0.2s; }
  #pacerai-homepage .nav-links > li > a:hover { color: var(--white); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); }
  #pacerai-homepage .nav-links > li > a .chevron { font-size: 10px; margin-top: 1px; transition: transform 0.2s; }
  #pacerai-homepage .nav-links > li:hover > a .chevron { transform: rotate(180deg); }
  #pacerai-homepage .dropdown { display: none; position: absolute; top: 100%; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); background: var(--navy-mid); border: 1px solid var(--navy-border); border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px; padding-top: 28px; min-width: 520px; box-shadow: 0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.6); }
  #pacerai-homepage .dropdown::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -12px; left: 0; right: 0; height: 12px; }
  #pacerai-homepage .nav-links > li:hover .dropdown { display: block; }
  #pacerai-homepage .dropdown-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 0 32px; }
  #pacerai-homepage .dropdown-col-label { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--teal); padding-bottom: 10px; margin-bottom: 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--navy-border); }
  #pacerai-homepage .dropdown a { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; padding: 10px; border-radius: 8px; text-decoration: none; transition: background 0.15s; }
  #pacerai-homepage .dropdown a:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); }
  #pacerai-homepage .dropdown .d-icon { width: 32px; height: 32px; flex-shrink: 0; background: var(--navy-light); border: 1px solid var(--navy-border); border-radius: 7px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 14px; }
  #pacerai-homepage .dropdown .d-text .d-title { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--white); display: block; line-height: 1.3; }
  #pacerai-homepage .dropdown .d-text .d-desc { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.4; margin-top: 2px; }
  #pacerai-homepage .single-dropdown { min-width: 220px; }
  #pacerai-homepage .single-dropdown a { padding: 9px 12px; border-radius: 8px; text-decoration: none; display: block; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-light); transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s; }
  #pacerai-homepage .single-dropdown a:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); color: var(--white); }
  #pacerai-homepage .mobile-menu-btn { display: none; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px; background: none; border: none; cursor: pointer; padding: 8px; z-index: 101; }
  #pacerai-homepage .mobile-menu-btn span { display: block; width: 22px; height: 2px; background: var(--text-light); border-radius: 2px; transition: all 0.3s; }
  #pacerai-homepage .mobile-menu-btn.open span:nth-child(1) { transform: rotate(45deg) translate(5px, 5px); }
  #pacerai-homepage .mobile-menu-btn.open span:nth-child(2) { opacity: 0; }
  #pacerai-homepage .mobile-menu-btn.open span:nth-child(3) { transform: rotate(-45deg) translate(5px, -5px); }
  #pacerai-homepage .nav-right { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; }
  #pacerai-homepage .btn-ghost { padding: 8px 18px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-light); background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--navy-border); border-radius: 7px; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; transition: all 0.2s; }
  #pacerai-homepage .btn-ghost:hover { color: var(--white); border-color: rgba(39,137,154,0.45); }
  #pacerai-homepage .btn-teal { padding: 9px 20px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; color: #fff; background: var(--teal); border: none; border-radius: 7px; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; transition: all 0.2s; letter-spacing: 0.02em; }
  #pacerai-homepage .btn-teal:hover { background: var(--teal-light); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(39,137,154,0.35); }

  /* ─── HERO ─── */
  #pacerai-homepage .hero { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; text-align: center; padding: 160px 24px 80px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
  #pacerai-homepage .hero-bg { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 0; background: radial-gradient(ellipse 900px 600px at 50% 30%, rgba(39,137,154,0.09) 0%, transparent 70%), radial-gradient(ellipse 600px 400px at 80% 60%, rgba(45,184,122,0.04) 0%, transparent 60%), linear-gradient(180deg, var(--navy) 0%, #0B1324 100%); }
  #pacerai-homepage .hero-bg::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background-image: linear-gradient(rgba(39,137,154,0.05) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(39,137,154,0.05) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 60px 60px; mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 60% at 50% 40%, black, transparent); }
  #pacerai-homepage .hero-eyebrow { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 16px 6px 8px; background: rgba(39,137,154,0.10); border: 1px solid rgba(39,137,154,0.22); border-radius: 100px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--teal); margin-bottom: 28px; animation: fadeUp 0.8s ease both; }
  #pacerai-homepage .hero-eyebrow .dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--teal); animation: pulse 2s infinite; }
  @keyframes pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } 50% { opacity: 0.5; transform: scale(0.8); } }
  #pacerai-homepage h1 { position: relative; z-index: 1; font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-size: clamp(42px, 6vw, 72px); font-weight: 300; line-height: 1.08; color: var(--white); letter-spacing: -0.01em; max-width: 860px; animation: fadeUp 0.8s 0.1s ease both; }
  #pacerai-homepage h1 em { font-style: italic; color: var(--teal); }
  #pacerai-homepage .hero-sub { position: relative; z-index: 1; font-size: 17px; font-weight: 300; color: var(--text-mid); max-width: 600px; line-height: 1.7; margin: 24px auto 40px; animation: fadeUp 0.8s 0.2s ease both; }
  #pacerai-homepage .hero-ctas { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; animation: fadeUp 0.8s 0.3s ease both; }
  #pacerai-homepage .btn-lg { padding: 14px 30px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: #fff; background: var(--teal); border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; letter-spacing: 0.02em; transition: all 0.25s; box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(39,137,154,0.30); }
  #pacerai-homepage .btn-lg:hover { background: var(--teal-light); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 10px 32px rgba(112,196,156,0.40); }
  #pacerai-homepage .btn-outline-lg { padding: 13px 28px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--white); background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15); border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none; transition: all 0.2s; }
  #pacerai-homepage .btn-outline-lg:hover { border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.35); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); }

  /* ─── SECTIONS ─── */
  #pacerai-homepage .section { padding: 100px 48px; }
  #pacerai-homepage .section-inner { max-width: 1080px; margin: 0 auto; }
  #pacerai-homepage .section-eyebrow { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--teal); margin-bottom: 16px; }
  #pacerai-homepage h2 { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-size: clamp(34px, 4.5vw, 56px); font-weight: 300; line-height: 1.1; color: var(--white); letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
  #pacerai-homepage h2 em { font-style: italic; color: var(--teal); }
  #pacerai-homepage .section-lead { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 300; color: var(--text-mid); max-width: 560px; line-height: 1.75; margin-top: 18px; }

  /* ─── MISSION CARD ─── */
  #pacerai-homepage .mission-card { background: var(--navy-mid); border: 1px solid var(--navy-border); border-left: 3px solid var(--teal); border-radius: 12px; padding: 40px 44px; margin-top: 48px; max-width: 860px; }
  #pacerai-homepage .mission-card p { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-size: 26px; font-weight: 300; font-style: italic; color: var(--white); line-height: 1.5; }

  /* ─── CONTRAST GRID ─── */
  #pacerai-homepage .contrast-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 24px; margin-top: 48px; }
  #pacerai-homepage .contrast-card { background: var(--navy-mid); border: 1px solid var(--navy-border); border-radius: 12px; padding: 36px; position: relative; }
  #pacerai-homepage .contrast-card .cc-label { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 20px; }
  #pacerai-homepage .contrast-card.old .cc-label { color: var(--red-subtle); }
  #pacerai-homepage .contrast-card.new .cc-label { color: var(--green); }
  #pacerai-homepage .contrast-card ul { list-style: none; }
  #pacerai-homepage .contrast-card ul li { font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-mid); line-height: 1.65; padding: 10px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--navy-border); display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; }
  #pacerai-homepage .contrast-card ul li:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
  #pacerai-homepage .contrast-card ul li .icon { flex-shrink: 0; font-size: 14px; margin-top: 2px; }

  /* ─── FOUNDER CARD ─── */
  #pacerai-homepage .founder-section { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 280px 1fr; gap: 48px; margin-top: 48px; align-items: start; }
  #pacerai-homepage .founder-avatar { width: 280px; height: 320px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--navy-light) 0%, var(--navy-mid) 100%); border: 1px solid var(--navy-border); border-radius: 16px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
  #pacerai-homepage .founder-avatar .avatar-placeholder { width: 120px; height: 120px; border-radius: 50%; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--brand) 0%, var(--teal) 100%); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-size: 48px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--white); }
  #pacerai-homepage .founder-info h3 { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif; font-size: 32px; font-weight: 400; color: var(--white); margin-bottom: 6px; }
  #pacerai-homepage .founder-info .founder-title { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--teal); letter-spacing: 0.04em; margin-bottom: 20px; }
  #pacerai-homepage .founder-info p { font-size: 15px; color: var(--text-mid); line-height: 1.8; margin-bottom: 16px; }
  #pacerai-homepage .founder-info .founder-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--teal); text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s; }
  #pacerai-homepage .founder-info .founder-link:hover { color: var(--teal-light); }

  /* ─── VALUES GRID ─── */
  #pacerai-homepage .values-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: 20px; margin-top: 48px; }
  #pacerai-homepage .value-card { background: var(--navy-mid); border: 1px solid var(--navy-border); border-radius: 12px; padding: 32px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
  #pacerai-homepage .value-card::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--brand), var(--teal), var(--teal-light)); }
  #pacerai-homepage .value-card .vc-icon { font-size: 28px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
  #pacerai-homepage .value-card h4 { font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--white); margin-bottom: 10px; line-height: 1.3; }
  #pacerai-homepage .value-card p { font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.65; }

  /* ─── PARTNERS STRIP ─── */
  #pacerai-homepage .partners-strip { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 56px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-top: 48px; padding: 40px 0; }
  #pacerai-homepage .partner-badge { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--text-mid); letter-spacing: 0.02em; opacity: 0.7; transition: opacity 0.2s; }
  #pacerai-homepage .partner-badge:hover { opacity: 1; }
  #pacerai-homepage .partner-badge .pb-icon { width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--navy-light); border: 1px solid var(--navy-border); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 20px; }

  /* ─── CTA ─── */
  #pacerai-homepage .cta-section { padding: 100px 48px; background: var(--navy-mid); border-top: 1px solid var(--navy-border); }
  #pacerai-homepage .cta-inner { max-width: 640px; margin: 0 auto; text-align: center; }
  #pacerai-homepage .cta-inner h2 { font-size: clamp(32px, 4vw, 52px); }
  #pacerai-homepage .cta-inner p { color: var(--text-mid); font-size: 16px; margin: 18px 0 40px; line-height: 1.7; }
  #pacerai-homepage .cta-buttons { display: flex; gap: 14px; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }

  /* ─── FOOTER ─── */
  #pacerai-homepage footer { background: var(--navy); border-top: 1px solid var(--navy-border); padding: 80px 48px 40px; }
  #pacerai-homepage .footer-top { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 240px 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 48px; padding-bottom: 64px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--navy-border); margin-bottom: 40px; }
  #pacerai-homepage .footer-brand p { font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.7; margin-top: 16px; }
  #pacerai-homepage .footer-col-head { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-light); margin-bottom: 20px; }
  #pacerai-homepage .footer-col ul { list-style: none; }
  #pacerai-homepage .footer-col ul li { margin-bottom: 10px; }
  #pacerai-homepage .footer-col ul li a { font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s; }
  #pacerai-homepage .footer-col ul li a:hover { color: var(--teal); }
  #pacerai-homepage .footer-bottom { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; }
  #pacerai-homepage .footer-bottom .copy { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); letter-spacing: 0.03em; }
  #pacerai-homepage .footer-bottom .legal { display: flex; gap: 24px; }
  #pacerai-homepage .footer-bottom .legal a { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s; }
  #pacerai-homepage .footer-bottom .legal a:hover { color: var(--text-mid); }

  @keyframes fadeUp { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }

  /* ═══ MOBILE ═══ */
  @media (max-width: 768px) {
    #pacerai-homepage nav { padding: 0 16px; height: 56px; backdrop-filter: none; background: #080E1C; overflow: visible; }
    #pacerai-homepage .nav-links { display: none !important; position: fixed; top: 56px; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; background: #080E1C; flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; padding: 16px 20px; overflow-y: auto; z-index: 200; border-top: 1px solid var(--navy-border); list-style: none; }
    #pacerai-homepage .nav-links.mobile-open { display: flex !important; }

    #pacerai-homepage .nav-links > li > a:hover { background: none; }
    #pacerai-homepage .nav-links .dropdown { position: static !important; transform: none !important; min-width: 0 !important; background: transparent !important; border: none !important; box-shadow: none !important; padding: 0 0 12px 16px !important; border-radius: 0 !important; padding-top: 0 !important; }
    #pacerai-homepage .nav-links .dropdown::before { display: none; }

    #pacerai-homepage .nav-links .dropdown-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    #pacerai-homepage .nav-right .btn-ghost { display: none; }
    #pacerai-homepage .nav-right .btn-teal { padding: 7px 14px; font-size: 12px; }
    #pacerai-homepage .mobile-menu-btn { display: flex !important; }

    #pacerai-homepage .hero { padding: 100px 20px 60px; }
    #pacerai-homepage h1 { font-size: 36px; max-width: 100%; }
    #pacerai-homepage .hero-sub { font-size: 15px; }
    #pacerai-homepage .hero-ctas { flex-direction: column; width: 100%; }
    #pacerai-homepage .hero-ctas .btn-lg, #pacerai-homepage .hero-ctas .btn-outline-lg { width: 100%; text-align: center; }

    #pacerai-homepage .section { padding: 60px 20px; }
    #pacerai-homepage .mission-card { padding: 28px 24px; }
    #pacerai-homepage .mission-card p { font-size: 20px; }
    #pacerai-homepage .contrast-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    #pacerai-homepage .founder-section { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 32px; }
    #pacerai-homepage .founder-avatar { width: 100%; height: 240px; }
    #pacerai-homepage .values-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    #pacerai-homepage .partners-strip { gap: 32px; }
    #pacerai-homepage .cta-section { padding: 60px 20px; }
    #pacerai-homepage .cta-buttons { flex-direction: column; align-items: center; }
    #pacerai-homepage .cta-buttons .btn-lg, #pacerai-homepage .cta-buttons .btn-outline-lg { width: 100%; text-align: center; }
    #pacerai-homepage footer { padding: 48px 20px 32px; }

    #pacerai-homepage .footer-brand { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
    #pacerai-homepage .footer-bottom { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; }

  }
  @media (max-width: 1024px) and (min-width: 769px) {

  }
